source: Compiled 2026-11-09 from ecu-manual/research/sci-commands-10-1B.md and sci-commands-1C-25.md, recovered/INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS.txt, SKIP_SHIFT_TRACE.txt, REVERSE_LOCKOUT_TRACE.txt, IDLE_AIR_FINDINGS.txt and data/service_manual_evidence.json, with each entry exercised in the VIP_2A03 emulator (key on, engine stopped); states are software requests, not measured relay or lamp current.

outputs.name: Rev limiter (fuel off above 6200 rpm)
outputs.confidence: confirmed in emulator: sets above 6200 rpm, clears at or below 5800
outputs.evidence: FUEL_CUT_FINDINGS.txt ordinary RPM limit 0135F8; fuel gate 011824

outputs.name: Speed limiter (rpm and road speed)
outputs.confidence: from research: needs more than 7000 rpm and road-speed word above 16320 (about 410 km/h), so it should never set
outputs.evidence: FUEL_CUT_FINDINGS.txt combined limit 0135B6

outputs.name: Deceleration fuel cut
outputs.confidence: from research: closed throttle above the idle target, warm, rolling (speed byte 64 or more, about 51 km/h) and running at least 10 timer units
outputs.evidence: FUEL_CUT_FINDINGS.txt decel entry 0134A6

outputs.name: Fuel inhibit (stored-state check)
outputs.confidence: confirmed in emulator; set when the co-processor EEPROM byte D88 has bit 01 clear. Purpose not identified.
outputs.evidence: INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS.txt 0250C6; fuel gate 011818

outputs.name: ASD (automatic shutdown) relay
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md test 0A (handler E4F0) and INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 013D90/013DAE/00E4F0. Emulator: 13 0A toggled F8106 FF<->BF and the firmware sent command 04 to select 1E with payload BF/B7 (qspi_log 04BF, 04B7). Without a test the bit is clear from reset for about 2.1 million instructions (key-on prime), then the event-loss path sets it and sends 04 FF. Bit clear = relay requested on. The byte as last queued to the co-processor is the shadow in shadow_address (it also carries the key-on mask: ROM 270E/270F/2710 = 08/90/C2 bits are forced clear until F811F.02 latches). Also in the SCI 1A 02 snapshot (F8350 bit 40).

outputs.name: Fuel pump relay (follows the ASD request)
outputs.evidence: No dedicated request bit found. The fuel-system command is 2D to select 1E (payload 60 on, 64 off; 70 at reset). INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 013D90/013DAE/028F24: the same routines that set or clear F8106.40 queue 2D 64 or 2D 60. Emulator: at key-on F8106.40 is clear; at icount ~2.11M the firmware sent 2D 64 and then set F8106.40 (04 FF). Actuator tests 1C and 33 and SCI command 18 send 2D 60/64 WITHOUT changing this bit (test 33 keeps its own state in F80D7 bit 02, set = on, seen 44<->46 with 2D 60 / 2D 64), so during those tests this indicator is wrong. Relay identity for command 2D is 'strong, not verified' in the research.

outputs.name: Radiator fan ON relay
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md tests 08/2E/2F; INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 01FA22 control_cooling_fan_requests. Emulator: 13 08, 13 2E and 13 2F each toggled F8107 bit 40 (FF<->BF) and the firmware sent command 26 to select 1E with payload BF/AF. Bit clear = requested on (the test restore sets the bit; the key-on engine-off state is set). The byte as last queued to the co-processor is the shadow in shadow_address (it also carries the key-on mask: ROM 270E/270F/2710 = 08/90/C2 bits are forced clear until F811F.02 latches). SCI 1A 03 returns the shadow.

outputs.name: Radiator fan low/high relay (high speed)
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md: test 2F (DRB 'high speed fan') clears F8108.01 and toggles F8107.40; test 2E ('low speed fan') sets F8108.01. Emulator: 13 2F and 13 08 changed F8108 3D->3C and the firmware sent command 04 to select 1D with payload 3C. Bit clear = high speed requested; that reading of the polarity rests on the DRB test names, not on a measured relay. The byte as last queued to the co-processor is the shadow in shadow_address (it also carries the key-on mask: ROM 270E/270F/2710 = 08/90/C2 bits are forced clear until F811F.02 latches). SCI 1A 04 returns the shadow.

outputs.name: A/C compressor clutch relay
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md test 09 (E4BE); INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 018588 control_air_conditioning_clutch_request. Emulator: 13 09 toggled F8107 FF<->DF and the firmware sent command 26 to select 1E with payload DF/CF/4F. Bit clear = requested on (restore sets the bit). The research notes raw polarity at the clutch is unmeasured. The byte as last queued to the co-processor is the shadow in shadow_address (it also carries the key-on mask: ROM 270E/270F/2710 = 08/90/C2 bits are forced clear until F811F.02 latches).

outputs.name: Check-engine lamp (MIL)
outputs.evidence: INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 015054 update_diagnostic_indicator_request: BCLR F8107.10 when a lamp request flag in F8886 is active, BSET otherwise. Emulator, no test sent: key-on shadow F8104 = 6F (bit 10 forced clear by the ROM 270F = 90 key-on mask, i.e. bulb check, command 26 payload 6F), then 26 FF at icount ~7.9M, then F8107 went FF->EF and 26 EF was sent at ~9.9M once the stand-in sensors had logged faults. Bit clear = lamp requested on. For the bulb check read shadow_address, not address. No actuator test exists for it; service_manual_evidence.json notes the lamp may also be driven by a CCD message.

outputs.name: Upshift (shift indicator) lamp
outputs.evidence: SKIP_SHIFT_TRACE.txt (F8107 bit 80, active-low software request; startup sets, 024A6E clears); sci-commands-10-1B.md test 17 (E796). Emulator: 13 17 toggled F8107 bit 80 (FF/EF <-> 7F/6F). The key-on mask ROM 270F = 90 forces this bit clear in the shadow at key-on (command 26 payload 6F), i.e. bulb check: read shadow_address to see that. Bit clear = lamp requested on.

outputs.name: Skip-shift (2-3 lockout) solenoid
outputs.evidence: SKIP_SHIFT_TRACE.txt (0249F4 -> F8107 bit 08 -> 029AFC -> command 26 select 1E); sci-commands-10-1B.md test 32 (E9D4). Emulator: 13 32 toggled F8107 FF<->F7 and the firmware sent command 26 with payload F7/E7/67. Bit clear = solenoid requested on (2nd/3rd blocked). In this calibration the normal entry gate needs coolant byte >= FE, so it stays off outside the test. The byte as last queued to the co-processor is the shadow in shadow_address (it also carries the key-on mask: ROM 270E/270F/2710 = 08/90/C2 bits are forced clear until F811F.02 latches).

outputs.name: Reverse-lockout solenoid
outputs.evidence: REVERSE_LOCKOUT_TRACE.txt: 024ADE sets F8502.20 when speed byte F80A4 > 06, clears it otherwise; 01A02A copies F8502 & 78 to PORTGP (FF907) and sets DDRGP (FF906) bits 78, 01A04A releases them. Emulator: at rest F8502 = 58 and the PORTGP latch = 58 (bit 20 clear); with RAM F80A4 held at 20 the firmware set F8502 to 78 and latched PORTGP = 78, and returned to 58 when released. 13 44 set the bit (58->78) for about 20,000 instructions before the normal speed logic cleared it again. Bit CLEAR = solenoid energised = reverse ALLOWED (manual: PCM grounds K136 below 5 mph); bit set = reverse blocked. The PCB driver/inversion between GP5 and C2-21 is untraced. Also SCI 1A 02 bit 20.

outputs.name: Speed-control servo vent solenoid
outputs.evidence: INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 02328C / 00E7CE; sci-commands-10-1B.md test 1A. Emulator: 13 1A toggled F8502 58<->48 with the PORTGP latch (FF907) following 58<->48 and PORTC.20 set; 13 0C cycled 58/48/40. Idle and restore state is bit set, so bit clear is taken as 'requested on'; the research says solenoid-current polarity is not established. Cruise hardware may not be fitted. No cavity in service_manual_evidence.json. Also SCI 1A 02 bit 10.

outputs.name: Speed-control servo vacuum solenoid
outputs.evidence: INTERRUPT_TASK_FINDINGS 02328C / 00E808; sci-commands-10-1B.md test 1B. Emulator: 13 1B toggled F8502 58<->50 with the PORTGP latch (FF907) following; 13 0C cycled both servo bits. Idle and restore state is bit set, so bit clear is taken as 'requested on'; electrical polarity not established. No cavity in service_manual_evidence.json. SCI 1A 02 reports it as bit 02.

outputs.name: Speed-control servo supply
outputs.evidence: PORTC latch bit 20. INPUT_MAP.md (PC5) and sci-commands-10-1B.md tests 2C/0C/1A/1B: the tests set FFA41.20, restore clears it. Emulator: 13 2C, 13 0C, 13 1A and 13 1B all showed FFA41 bit 20 set (values 20/30/60) where the baseline never has it; SCI 1A 02 bit 01 is the inverse (9F->9E). Bit set = supply requested on at the software level; active-high electrical switching is not established. Read only bit 20: bits 10 and 40 of the same register are the analog multiplexer selects and alternate continuously.

outputs.name: EVAP purge solenoid (duty value)
outputs.evidence: A byte value, not a single bit: the purge value last queued by the normal purge routines (014386/0147A6/01DF10) or test 0B, sent as command 39 to select 1E. Emulator: 13 0B set F8635 = 80 and sent 39 80; with no test, reset leaves FF (39 FF sent at start) and the shutdown countdown writes 00 and sends 39 00 at icount ~5.56M. Research (command 25 item 01, 'strong'): FF = full on, 00 = off. SCI 25 01 overrides send 39 FF / 39 00 directly and do NOT update this byte (observed: 25 01 01 sent 39 FF with F8635 unchanged; F8129 bit 20 is set while an override is active).

outputs.name: Idle-air motor (requested position, steps)
outputs.evidence: A step count, not on/off. IDLE_AIR_FINDINGS.txt: F8612 = requested position (cap D2), F8810 = tracked position already handed to the co-processor; 0223B6/022432 send moves as command 22 to select 1E (up to 1F steps per packet), status polled with command 36 into F8615. Emulator: after reset F8612 = 8B and F8810 stepped 00,1F,3E,5D,7C,8B while 22 7F x4 and 22 6F were sent; 13 07 produced runs of 22 FF / 22 7F packets and 13 3B one 22 61. The motor is being moved whenever F8612 != F8810. Four winding drivers on C3; which winding is energised is decided by the co-processor.

outputs.name: Generator field (forced full-field test state only)
outputs.evidence: Only the diagnostic force state, NOT normal charging. sci-commands-10-1B.md test 0D (E5A6): toggles F8109.20 and sends command 80 to select 1E with payload 86 (bit set) or 06 (clear). Emulator: 13 0D toggled F8109 00<->20 and sent 80 86 / 80 06. The same command 80 payload 86 is sent by the charging monitor 01A3B2 (state F8497 bit 80) and by SCI 25 11 (state F8129 bit 40; refused engine-off in the emulator). Normal field regulation has no main-CPU state bit in the research; it appears to be left to the co-processor.

outputs.name: Unidentified output (actuator test 15)
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md test 15 (E724): toggles F8107.02, output not identified, normal writer 01CDBC unresolved. Emulator: 13 15 toggled F8107 FF<->FD and sent command 26 with payload FD/ED/6D. Polarity assumed the same as the other F8107 bits (clear = on); not established.

outputs.name: Unidentified output on timer pin GP6 (actuator test 3D)
outputs.evidence: sci-commands-10-1B.md test 3D (EA8C) and command 25 item 13: toggles F8502.40, device not identified (normal writers 01D9F8/02615C/026A38, leak/purge monitor family). Emulator: 13 3D toggled F8502 58<->18 with the PORTGP latch (FF907) following; 25 13 01 held it at 18. Polarity assumed like the other F8502 bits (clear = on); not established. SCI 1A 02 reports it as bit 04.
